prayerExcerpt.en-US: We are enlisted in the same service as the holy martyrs, and we too must have courage and constancy if we would be perfect soldiers of Jesus Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Estamos alistados no mesmo serviço que os santos mártires, e também nós devemos ter coragem e constância se quisermos ser perfeitos soldados de Jesus Cristo.

meta.face: A Greek of the East of about twenty-two, a recruit, with a warm olive complexion and a NARROW, LONG face with a CLASSICAL GREEK PROFILE — the nose continuing the line of the forehead WITHOUT a dip, long and straight, LARGE, dark, ALMOND eyes under HEAVY upper lids and long, level black brows, lean cheeks, a SMALL, full, firmly closed mouth, a NARROW chin; thick, straight, glossy BLACK hair falling in a full bowl OVER the ears; a SHORT, dense, BLACK young beard, as the Painter's Manual has him; the gaze steady and calm. Not the curly young george and sebastian, the hawkish eustachius, the joined-browed romanus_ostiarius, the round, grizzled marcellus_centurion, the smooth, beardless pantaleon or the bell-shaped theodoret_antioch.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual of Dionysius of Fourna (`consult/hermeneia-ocr.txt`, 17 February) gives Theodore Teron 'a black beard, and his hair coming down over his ears'; the young face follows his name (the Recruit) and the book ('while still a youth'). Amasea is the Martyrology's place.
